about: The mandatory sandbox ('required' level of GET /collect/capabilities local_box) for the CLI (src/box/required.js) and the desktop app (apps/server/src/box/required.ts): what a client told required:true does, the setup it runs per OS, the build-artefact shadows on macOS/Windows hosts and the projects that stay on the host. Shared byte for byte (src/box/PARITY.sha256 and apps/server/src/box/PARITY.sha256).

launch_record.about: What client.launch `box` says under required: {required: true, reason, fallback, capable}. In the box: capable true, no fallback. cannot_run: this machine can't run the box (no virtualization, setup not possible or not done yet, a box that failed to start): capable false, fallback native (counted in full). opted_out: it could, but the box was turned off (--no-sandbox / OMNIRUSH_BOX=0) or the setup declined: capable true, fallback = the server's required_fallback. kept: an old chat or a host-only project, on this machine as before: fallback native, capable not checked (absent). Any other reason on this machine reads as cannot_run.

host_only.about: Projects that only build and run on their own OS: their new chats stay on the machine and count as today (launch reason host_only). Markers are matched in the project root and one level down.

shadows.about: On macOS/Windows hosts the box keeps its own Linux copy of each build-artefact folder, so the host's builds are never written and the host's Mac/Windows builds never run in the box. Tools that can be pointed elsewhere get an environment variable (no folder appears on the host); node_modules (harmless when empty) and folders that already exist on the host are bind-mounted from the box's own disk (boxrun init Binds). Shadows are never in the box snapshots: a rebuild recreates them from the manifests and the recorded installs. Linux hosts: none.

install_script: function Add-Log([string]$line) { try { $line | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $log } catch {} }

image.about: The VM's disk. custom: OmniRush's own small Debian image (box/vm), sha256 per arch from the box-<version> release (box-images workflow; null: not published); fallback: the official Debian genericcloud image, pinned by its published sha512.

cli.required_line: This account runs new chats in the OmniRush sandbox, a Linux box set up for you, so sessions can be rebuilt.
cli.opt_out_refused: The sandbox is required for new chats on this account; chats started before stay as they were.
cli.kept_old_chat: This chat started on this machine before the sandbox was required, so it stays here.
cli.native_model: {model} runs on this machine, not in the sandbox, so this chat stays here.
cli.host_only: This project only builds on {label} ({things}), so its chats run on {machine}.
cli.shadows: In the sandbox, {dirs} are the sandbox's own Linux copies; your {label} copies are left as they are. Install dependencies inside as needed.
cli.cannot_run: The sandbox can't run on this computer: {why}. This chat runs on {machine}.
cli.win_setup: The sandbox needs WSL 2. Run `omnirush sandbox setup` (one Windows admin prompt, then a restart).
cli.win_restart: WSL 2 is installed; restart Windows to finish. OmniRush finishes the setup on its next start.
cli.win_updating: WSL is updating for the sandbox in the background; this chat runs on this PC, the next one in the sandbox.

desktop.required_line: New chats run in the OmniRush sandbox, set up for you.
desktop.opt_out_refused: Required for new chats on this account. Chats started before keep running where they started.
desktop.kept_old_chat: Started on this computer before the sandbox was required: it stays here.
desktop.host_only: This project only builds on {label} ({things}), so its chats run on {machine}.
desktop.shadows: In the sandbox, {dirs} are the sandbox's own Linux copies; your {label} copies are left as they are.
desktop.cannot_run: The sandbox can't run on this computer: {why}.

why.firmware_off: virtualization is turned off in the BIOS/UEFI settings (Intel VT-x or AMD SVM)
why.nested_vm: this Windows runs inside a virtual machine without nested virtualization
why.s_mode: Windows in S mode can't run WSL
why.old_windows: Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later is needed
